verdict.rationale: Any product with a public documentation site could reasonably publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so this axis applies to vLLM. A direct probe of https://docs.vllm.ai/llms.txt returned HTTP 404, and nothing else in the pack shows an llms.txt, llms-full.txt, or agent-targeted documentation. Tool calling and the OpenAI-compatible API are runtime features, not agent-consumable docs, so they earn no credit here.
